bibliographic.title: The Travelers and the Sea
bibliographic.author: Adrianna Ramirez
bibliographic.description: The true characters in the game would be the travelers. These travelers would go in search of the treasure that they thought was there. They would make decisions on what to look at and look for. The player in the beginning will choose one of three paths. From there they could either decide to swim, ride a boat, look around, and walk down the shore. They can as well, have the choice to give up throughout their journey. The ending of the game would be either finding the treasure or not finding the treasure.
